description.value: Jo-E Cycles, branded online as Jo-E Bike Rentals, is a dedicated bike and e-bike rental shop steps from the entrance to Stanley Park on Denman Street in Vancouver. The shop claims to be Vancouver's first e-bike rental business and maintains a wide fleet including comfort cruisers, city hybrids, mountain bikes, tandems, kids bikes, and multiple e-bike models — all with helmets, locks, and baskets included. Renters benefit from an on-demand rescue team dispatched to their location in the event of a flat tire or mechanical issue mid-ride.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 57m; stands (2 spaces) at 58m; stands (2 spaces) at 92m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Jo-E Cycles is a well-established, tourist-facing bike rental operation directly adjacent to Stanley Park — one of BC's premier cycling destinations — making it genuinely useful to touring cyclists seeking rentals or local route guidance.
